title: Winter Holidays
story: Lights, gifts and cocoa to make the coldest days the warmest.

cards.name: Candy Cane
cards.subject: A candy cane: a straight stick curving into a round hook at the top, with diagonal red and white stripes along its whole length.
cards.hero_colors: red and white stripes

cards.name: Gift Box
cards.subject: A square gift box with a flat lid, a ribbon band running over the lid and down all four sides, and a symmetrical bow with two loops on top.
cards.hero_colors: red box, white ribbon

cards.name: Cocoa Mug
cards.subject: A round mug with one handle on the side, filled with brown hot cocoa and topped with three white marshmallows, standing on a wooden table.
cards.hero_colors: red mug, brown cocoa, white marshmallows

cards.name: Pine Tree
cards.subject: A tall symmetrical fir tree in three tiers with small round red baubles hanging on its branches, standing in snow.
cards.hero_colors: green tree, small red baubles

cards.name: Mittens
cards.subject: A pair of knitted mittens, each with a thumb and a ribbed cuff and a white snowflake icon on the back, laid side by side with fingers pointing up.
cards.hero_colors: blue mittens, white snowflake icons, white cuffs

cards.name: Cookie Plate
cards.subject: A round plate seen from above holding star-shaped and round sugar cookies with white icing; the round cookies have a dot of red jam in the middle.
cards.hero_colors: white plate, tan cookies, white icing, red jam

cards.name: Fireplace
cards.subject: A red brick fireplace with a wooden mantel shelf and an open arch holding a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, glowing orange ends on the logs, and warm orange light cast on the bricks; a stocking with a white cuff hangs from a hook on the mantel front.
cards.hero_colors: red bricks, brown wood mantel, orange fire, white stocking cuff
cards.surface_or_setting: living-room wall with a stone hearth floor in front

cards.name: Bauble
cards.subject: A perfectly round glass ball ornament with a small silver cap on top with a loop on the cap, and a white swirl line around it.
cards.hero_colors: blue ball, silver cap, white swirl

cards.name: Sled
cards.subject: A wooden sled with a seat of five parallel slats resting on two long metal runners that curl up at the front, joined by a red painted crossbar at the front, standing on snow.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown slats, grey metal runners, red crossbar

cards.name: Door Wreath
cards.subject: A perfectly round wreath of green pine branches with a red bow at the bottom and a few small pine cones, hanging from a hook at the top of a closed wooden front door.
cards.hero_colors: green wreath, brown pine cones, red bow
cards.surface_or_setting: wooden front door with a small snowy doorstep

cards.name: Pine Tree
cards.subject: A tall symmetrical fir tree in three tiers with a few small round gold baubles on its branches and a short round pot at the base.
cards.hero_colors: green tree, small gold baubles, brown pot

cards.name: Candy Cane
cards.subject: A candy cane: a straight stick curving into a round hook at the top, with diagonal red and white stripes along its whole length.
cards.hero_colors: red and white stripes

cards.name: Gift Boxes
cards.subject: Two stacked square gift boxes, a big one at the bottom and a smaller one on top, each with a ribbon band across the lid and down the sides, and a bow on the top box.
cards.hero_colors: blue boxes, gold ribbon

cards.name: Jingle Bell
cards.subject: A round brass jingle bell: a ball with a horizontal slit at the bottom, a small hole below the slit and a small loop on top.
cards.hero_colors: gold

cards.name: Ice Skates
cards.subject: A pair of white lace-up ice skates, each a high boot with laces and a long silver blade bolted under the sole, standing side by side on ice.
cards.hero_colors: white boots, silver blades, red laces

cards.name: Snow Globe
cards.subject: A perfectly round glass dome on a round wooden base, with a small green pine tree inside and white flakes floating in the water.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, green pine tree, brown wood base

cards.name: Door Wreath
cards.subject: A perfectly round wreath of green pine branches with a white bow at the bottom, hanging from a hook at the top of a closed front door.
cards.hero_colors: green wreath, white bow

cards.name: Stocking
cards.subject: A red holiday stocking with a white fluffy cuff, a green heel and a green toe, hanging by a loop from a hook on the front of a wooden mantel shelf.

cards.surface_or_setting: front of a wooden mantel shelf on a plain wall

cards.name: Light Strand

cards.backdrop_colors: royal blue night sky with a few small stars and a crescent moon
cards.surface_or_setting: wooden eave edge of a cottage roof

cards.name: Knit Hat

cards.hero_colors: green tree, small red baubles

cards.name: Candy Jar

cards.name: Sleigh

cards.name: Lamp Post

cards.name: Scarf
cards.subject: A knitted scarf seen from above, laid out straight, with wide stripes across it and short fringe on both ends.
cards.hero_colors: blue and white stripes, white fringe, one red stripe

cards.name: Holly

cards.hero_colors: green leaves, red berries

cards.hero_colors: clear glass, green pine tree, brown wood base

cards.hero_colors: green wreath, red berries, red bow
